command.name: Shimmering Mirage
verbatim: Each Round: 50% chance to gain 1 stack of Mirage (Max 10 Stacks).
Rounds 3, 6, 9: Deal Fire Damage to 1 Enemy within adjacency (Damage Rate: +200%).
Mirage: Increase your Fire Damage Dealt by +2.5% per stack. Max 10 stacks.

vanguard.name: Hunter's Cunning
vanguard.verbatim: At Level 16+ and deployed in the Vanguard, increase your Recovery Received by +20% and Intelligence by +25. Increase Physical Damage Dealt by +10% of the Ally deployed in the Right Flank.

habits.name: Enervate
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Reduce Tactical Damage Dealt by -10% of 1 Enemy that deals Tactical Damage until the end of combat.

habits.name: Dragon's Cunning
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Increase your Intelligence by +12% and reduce Instinct by -10% (enhanced by Initiative) of 2 Enemies within adjacency. Each effect lasts until the end of combat.

habits.name: Cunning Ruse
verbatim: Each Round: 25% chance to gain 1 stack of Mirage (Max 10 Stacks).
Each stack of Mirage increases your Fire Damage Dealt by +2.5% until the end of combat.

Each Round: If you have 4 or more stacks of Mirage, there is a 10% chance to afflict 3 Enemies in any lane with Weakened (-15%) for 2 round(s). This chance is checked separately for each target and is doubled (20%) against targets that deal Tactical Damage.

habits.name: Battle Guile
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Reduce Instinct and Initiative by -5% (enhanced by Initiative) of 3 Enemies in any lane until the end of combat.

habits.name: Veiled Ambush
verbatim: Each Round: 25% chance to gain 1 stack of Mirage (Max 10 Stacks).
Each stack of Mirage increases your Fire Damage Dealt by +2.5% until the end of combat.
Each Round: If you have 7 or more stacks of Mirage, deal Fire Damage (Damage Rate: +150%) to the Enemy with the most troops. This effect can only trigger once per combat.
